model_output.verdict: A senior B2B SaaS marketer whose recent consulting work leaves a recruiter guessing about its reach.
write_up: Your Velocity role shows senior marketing ownership: a team, a budget and demand generation for a $40M ARR B2B SaaS company. Your current freelance work names deliverables, but not how many projects you handled or what changed. A recruiter may hesitate there and move on.

The MQL line is your best model. It pairs a concrete result with a second measure, cost per lead, without making a recruiter guess what improved. Bring some of that detail to the consulting projects and earlier Bridgepoint work.
